basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer | Production LLM & Agent Systems | Full-Stack
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who ships production code, not just plans. I lead technical delivery of AI agent systems at LumApps end to end: discovery, architecture, full-stack build (Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, Google ADK), and production rollout, with eval pipelines that turn field signal into product decisions. I run Anand Creations on the side, my own forward deployed practice, and have taken three products from prototype to production myself in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where I own the trade-off calls. 13+ years writing and shipping production software for millions of users, staying in the code and on-call for what I build.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems, turning field signal into product decisions.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer: owns the problem, writes the code, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (prototype to production). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.

Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end, owning discovery through production and GTM with Sales. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA.
Built GenAI demo system for sales that auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates.

Designed a distributed templating engine and reusable module framework that cut customer setup time 90% and now powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users): a building block others build on, not a one-off.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live production test for autonomous systems.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents: calm judgment when the stakes are physical.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Forward Deployed Engineering, Zurich, Switzerland (hybrid, 3 days/week in office, up to 50% travel, relocation assistance offered). FDEs lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside strategic customers: own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams. Success measured through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. Responsibilities: own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production; build full-stack systems that deliver customer value; embed closely with customer teams and guide adoption; scope work, sequence delivery, remove blockers early; make scope/speed/quality trade-offs; contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it; codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks others can use; share field feedback with Research and Product; keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through. Requirements: 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience including customer-facing work; scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments; production-grade code across frontend and backend (Python, JavaScript, or comparable); built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behavior affects product experience; simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure; communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders; spot risks early and adjust without slowing down; model calm and judgment when the stakes are high.
